channel.title: PNallDR
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Potential Army secretary candidates emerge as Trump weighs replacement
item.description: Names like Sean Parnell and Brian Mast surface as possible successors to Dan Driscoll, following reported disagreements with Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Paxton says Texas voters need more info on Talarico
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton remarked that Democrat James Talarico is performing well in a traditionally Republican state, suggesting voters are not fully informed.

item.title: House passes bill imposing lifetime no-contact orders for convicted felons
item.description: Rep. Abe Hamadeh's Kayleigh's Law, which mandates permanent no-contact orders for sex offenders and violent felons, passed the House with unanimous support.

item.title: Ocasio-Cortez endorses Angie Nixon in Florida Senate race
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez announced her endorsement of Florida state Rep. Angie Nixon, a Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate, in her bid against the Republican opponent.
